function.description: Apply for a credit card.

function.name: submit_referral
function.description: Submit a referral request to refer someone to open an account.

user_id.description: Your user ID (the referrer)
user_id.title: User Id

account_type.description: The type of account you are referring someone to open
account_type.title: Account Type

function.name: call_discoverable_user_tool
function.description:
Call a tool that was given to you by the agent.

Use this when the agent has instructed you to perform an action using
a discoverable tool. The agent will have told you the tool name and arguments.

This simulates you performing the action in the real world (e.g., opening
a webpage, navigating to a section, clicking a button).

discoverable_tool_name.description: The name of the discoverable tool to call (e.g., "open_webpage")
discoverable_tool_name.title: Discoverable Tool Name

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"url": "https://example.com"}')
arguments.title: Arguments

function.name: list_discoverable_user_tools
function.description:
List all tools that have been given to you by the agent.

Use this to see what actions the agent has instructed you to perform.

function.name: request_human_agent_transfer
function.description:
Request to be transferred to a human agent for assistance.

Use this when you want to speak with a real human agent instead of
the automated system. Each request will be logged and processed.

function.name: submit_transaction
function.description: Submit a credit card transaction.

user_id.description: Your user ID
user_id.title: User Id

credit_card_type.description: Type of credit card used (e.g., "Bronze Rewards Card", "Gold Rewards Card")
credit_card_type.title: Credit Card Type

merchant_name.description: Name of the merchant where the purchase was made
merchant_name.title: Merchant Name
